summary.title: Unified device picker and pump-based basal steps
changes: Device selection now uses a single grouped picker with manufacturer sections and device icons.
CGM hint lists no longer show unreachable entries like Dexcom Share and FreeStyle Libre Demo.
Onboarding and therapy settings use pump-provided basal increments; Dana now offers 0.01 steps and zero is excluded.
Device icons are resolved from each kit's bundled artwork, with a category glyph fallback for missing assets.
